mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_behavior_daily ( corp_id, userid, user_name, stat_time, new_apply_cnt, new_contact_cnt, chat_cnt, message_cnt, reply_percentage, avg_reply_time, negative_feedback_cnt, raw_json, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{corpId}, #{userid}, #{userName}, #{statTime}, #{newApplyCnt}, #{newContactCnt}, #{chatCnt}, #{messageCnt}, #{replyPercentage}, #{avgReplyTime}, #{negativeFeedbackCnt}, #{rawJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (userid, stat_time) DO UPDATE SET corp_id = EXCLUDED.corp_id, user_name = EXCLUDED.user_name, new_apply_cnt = EXCLUDED.new_apply_cnt, new_contact_cnt = EXCLUDED.new_contact_cnt, chat_cnt = EXCLUDED.chat_cnt, message_cnt = EXCLUDED.message_cnt, reply_percentage = EXCLUDED.reply_percentage, avg_reply_time = EXCLUDED.avg_reply_time, negative_feedback_cnt = EXCLUDED.negative_feedback_cnt, raw_json = EXCLUDED.raw_json, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT userid, MAX(user_name) AS name FROM crm_wecom_behavior_daily GROUP BY userid
